ruleDefinitions.name: Service Installation with Suspicious Folder Pattern
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects service installation with suspicious folder patterns Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ImagePath

sequences.query: ((Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045) AND (ImagePath = RGX("^[Cc]:\[Pp]rogram[Dd]ata\.{1,9}.exe") OR ImagePath = RGX("^[Cc]:\.{1,9}.exe")))
